findings.description: The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects such as the vendor roster can be stored without an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest control.
The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption, so exported ledger data is not protected by an explicit encryption-at-rest requirement.

Versioning and access logging are configured, but no default server-side encryption is configured for the model-artifact objects themselves. Consequently, artifact uploads lack an explicit encryption-at-rest control.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, leaving runbook objects without an explicitly configured encryption-at-rest safeguard.
